entities.summary: Mason Graham is an American professional football defensive tackle for the Cleveland Browns of the National Football League (NFL). He was a two-time All-American playing college football for the Michigan Wolverines, including unanimous All-American honors in 2024. In 2023, he won a national championship and was the Rose Bowl defensive MVP. Graham was selected by the Browns with the fifth overall pick in the first round of the 2025 NFL draft.
